name: Pumpkin
description: (Tag:gun)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Dubbed "Roman Artillery", Pumpkin is a large gun Teigu that fires energy-beam projectiles using your energy reserves in sniper, rifle, and machine-gun modes. Output amplifies with your danger and emotional state. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
